column1: # cGAS-STING / Type-I-IFN / IL-6 / ISG host reactivation gene panel
# Purpose: input panel for bin/score_host_reactivation.py, which computes a
# (the v2.0.0 host-quant arm output; params.run_host_quant). Built for the
# Phase I STTR application (Ataraxia Bio / Price Lab) Preliminary Data
# deliverable: a per-donor cGAS-STING/type-I-IFN/IL-6/ISG reactivation score,
# tested for correlation against existing viral RPM data.
# Format: gene_id <tab> gene_symbol <tab> gene_biotype <tab> category <tab> source <tab> notes
# Lines starting with # are comments. gene_id matches the gene_id column of
#   - category=type_I_IFN_response_ISG (102 genes): 97 genes are the verbatim
#     Liberzon et al. 2015 Cell Systems; Subramanian et al. 2005 PNAS GSEA),
#     downloaded directly from gsea-msigdb.org 2026-07-15 and used unmodified.
#     5 additional canonical ISGs (MX2, OAS2, OAS3, IFIT1, RIGI/DDX58) were
#     added by hand because they are widely used in the ISG-signature
#     literature but are confirmed (by direct membership check against the
#     downloaded file) to be absent from the Hallmark IFN-alpha set.
#     pathway *signaling machinery* (CGAS, STING1, TBK1, IKBKE, IRF3, IFNB1).
#     These are deliberately NOT drawn from a Hallmark "response" gene set,
#     which captures transcriptional output, not the upstream sensor/adaptor/
#     kinase/TF machinery itself. Gene symbols use current HGNC nomenclature
#     as it appears in GENCODE v48 (CGAS not MB21D1; STING1 not TMEM173).
#     Key refs: Sun et al. 2013 Science (cGAS); Ishikawa & Barber 2008 Nature
#   - category=IL6_JAK_STAT3_axis (88 genes): 87 genes are the verbatim MSigDB
#     source/date as above, used unmodified. Note this Hallmark set is a
#     general gp130/JAK/STAT3 signaling set (it includes many cytokine/
#     receptor genes beyond IL-6 itself, e.g. IL1B, CSF2, LTBR, IFNAR1) -- it
#     is NOT an IL-6-specific gene list. It was chosen anyway for defensibility
#     (verbatim public gene set, not hand-picked) with this caveat documented
#     here. IL6R was added by hand because it is confirmed absent from the
#     Hallmark set (which includes IL6 and IL6ST but not the receptor IL6R).
# 8 genes appear in two categories (semicolon-joined in the category column)
# because they are members of more than one source gene set (e.g. CXCL10,
# CXCL11, CSF1 appear in both the IFN-alpha and IL6/JAK/STAT3 Hallmark sets).
# All 188 gene symbols resolved cleanly (0 unmatched) against
# Built 2026-07-15 as part of the host-quant-arm smoke-test / STTR Preliminary
